```{r}
harmonise_to_als <- function(df_raw, ref_panel, name = "trait") {
  # Clean and coerce types in the disease dataset
  df2 <- df_raw %>%
    mutate(
      chr     = as.numeric(gsub("^chr", "", chr)),  # handles "3" or "chr3"
      pos     = as.numeric(pos),
      beta    = as.numeric(beta),
      SE      = as.numeric(SE),
      A1_raw  = as.character(A1_raw),
      A2_raw  = as.character(A2_raw)
    )

  # Coerce types in reference too
  ref2 <- ref_panel %>%
    mutate(
      chr = as.numeric(chr),
      pos = as.numeric(pos)
    )

  # Join on chr + pos
  merged <- df2 %>%
    inner_join(ref2, by = c("chr", "pos"))

  # How do alleles relate to ALS REF/ALT?
  same <- merged$A1_raw == merged$ALT_ref & merged$A2_raw == merged$REF_ref
  flip <- merged$A1_raw == merged$REF_ref & merged$A2_raw == merged$ALT_ref

  # Guard against NAs in same/flip
  ok <- (same | flip) & !is.na(same) & !is.na(flip)
  if (!all(ok)) {
    message(name, ": dropping ", sum(!ok), " SNPs with incompatible alleles.")
    merged <- merged[ok, , drop = FALSE]
    flip   <- flip[ok]
  }

  # Make absolutely sure beta is numeric before flipping
  merged$beta <- as.numeric(merged$beta)
  merged$beta[flip] <- -merged$beta[flip]

  # Final harmonised output: ALS orientation + ALS MAF
  out <- merged %>%
    mutate(
      SNP = SNP_ref,
      A1  = ALT_ref,
      A2  = REF_ref,
      REF = REF_ref,
      ALT = ALT_ref,
      MAF = MAF_ref
    ) %>%
    select(chr, pos, SNP, A1, A2, beta, SE, P, MAF, REF, ALT)

  out
}


ALS_h <- harmonise_to_als(ALS_raw, ref_panel, "ALS")
PSP_h <- harmonise_to_als(PSP_raw, ref_panel, "PSP")
PD_h  <- harmonise_to_als(PD_raw,  ref_panel, "PD")
AD_h  <- harmonise_to_als(AD_raw,  ref_panel, "AD")
MSA_h <- harmonise_to_als(MSA_raw, ref_panel, "MSA")
FTD_h <- harmonise_to_als(FTD_raw, ref_panel, "FTD")
CJD_h <- harmonise_to_als(CJD_raw, ref_panel, "CJD")
```

```{r}

harmonise_by_snp <- function(df_raw, ref_panel, trait = "trait") {

  df2 <- df_raw %>%
    mutate(
      SNP    = as.character(SNP),
      A1_raw = as.character(A1_raw),
      A2_raw = as.character(A2_raw),
      beta   = as.numeric(beta),
      SE     = as.numeric(SE),
      P      = as.numeric(P)
    )

  ref2 <- ref_panel %>%
    mutate(
      SNP    = as.character(SNP),
      REF_ref = as.character(REF_ref),
      ALT_ref = as.character(ALT_ref)
    )

  merged <- df2 %>% inner_join(ref2, by = "SNP")

  if (nrow(merged) == 0) {
    warning(trait, ": no overlapping SNPs with ALS by rsID.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # allele matching
  same <- merged$A1_raw == merged$ALT_ref & merged$A2_raw == merged$REF_ref
  flip <- merged$A1_raw == merged$REF_ref & merged$A2_raw == merged$ALT_ref

  ok <- (same | flip) & !is.na(same) & !is.na(flip)

  if (!all(ok)) {
    message(trait, ": dropping ", sum(!ok), " SNPs with incompatible alleles.")
    merged <- merged[ok, , drop = FALSE]
    flip   <- flip[ok]
  }

  merged$beta <- as.numeric(merged$beta)
  merged$beta[flip] <- -merged$beta[flip]

  merged %>%
    transmute(
      chr = chr,            # <— no suffix needed
      pos = pos,
      SNP,
      A1  = ALT_ref,        # effect allele = ALS ALT
      A2  = REF_ref,
      beta,
      SE,
      P,
      MAF = MAF_ref,        # use ALS MAF
      REF = REF_ref,
      ALT = ALT_ref
    )
}

harmonise_simple <- function(df_raw, ref_panel, name="TRAIT") {
  
  merged <- df_raw %>%
    inner_join(ref_panel, by="SNP")
  
  if (nrow(merged) == 0) {
    stop(name, ": no overlapping SNPs with ALS.")
  }
  
  # compatibility: same orientation
  same <- merged$A1_raw == merged$ALT_ref & merged$A2_raw == merged$REF_ref
  
  # reversed orientation → flip beta
  flip <- merged$A1_raw == merged$REF_ref & merged$A2_raw == merged$ALT_ref
  
  ok <- same | flip
  
  if (!all(ok)) {
    message(name, ": dropping ", sum(!ok), " incompatible SNPs.")
    merged <- merged[ok, ]
    flip   <- flip[ok]
  }
  
  # flip beta if alleles reversed
  merged$beta[flip] <- -merged$beta[flip]
  
  # output in ALS orientation with ALS MAF
  merged %>%
    transmute(
      SNP,
      A1 = ALT_ref,   # effect allele always ALS ALT
      A2 = REF_ref,
      beta,
      SE,
      P,
      MAF = MAF_ref,
      REF = REF_ref,
      ALT = ALT_ref
    )
}

ALS_h <- harmonise_simple(ALS_raw, ref_panel, "ALS")
PSP_h <- harmonise_simple(PSP_raw, ref_panel, "PSP")
PD_h  <- harmonise_simple(PD_raw,  ref_panel, "PD")
AD_h <- harmonise_by_snp(AD_raw, ref_panel, "AD")

MSA_h <- harmonise_simple(MSA_raw, ref_panel, "MSA")
CJD_h <- harmonise_simple(CJD_raw, ref_panel, "CJD")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# list of harmonised datasets
disease_list <- list(
  ALS = ALS_h,
  PSP = PSP_h,
  PD  = PD_h,
  MSA = MSA_h,
  AD  = AD_h,
  CJD = CJD_h,
  FTD = FTD_h
)
beta_mat <- reduce(
  lapply(names(disease_list), function(name) {
    disease_list[[name]] %>%
      select(SNP, beta) %>%
      rename(!!paste0("beta_", name) := beta)
  }),
  full_join,
  by = "SNP"
)
p_mat <- reduce(
  lapply(names(disease_list), function(name) {
    disease_list[[name]] %>%
      select(SNP, P) %>%
      rename(!!paste0("p_", name) := P)
  }),
  full_join,
  by = "SNP"
)
annot <- ALS_h %>% select(SNP, REF, ALT, MAF)


full_tbl <- annot %>%
  left_join(beta_mat, by = "SNP") %>%
  left_join(p_mat,     by = "SNP")
beta_only <- full_tbl %>% select(starts_with("beta_"))
corr_mat <- cor(beta_only, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
corr_mat

library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)

melt_corr <- melt(corr_mat)

ggplot(melt_corr, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits=c(-1,1)) +
  geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.2f", value)), size=3, color="white") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
  labs(title="Cross-Disease Effect Size Correlation")
df <- full_tbl %>% select(SNP, beta_ALS, beta_PSP) %>% drop_na()

ggplot(df, aes(beta_ALS, beta_PSP)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, color="red") +
  theme_classic(base_size=14) +
  labs(title="ALS vs PSP SNP Effect Sizes")

library(pheatmap)

heat_df <- full_tbl %>%
  select(starts_with("beta_")) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(heat_df) <- full_tbl$SNP

pheatmap(heat_df, scale="row")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(pheatmap)
library(patchwork)

```

```{r}
# convert P → –log10(P)
p_mat <- full_tbl %>%
  select(starts_with("p_")) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ -log10(pmax(., 1e-300))))

# correlation matrix
p_corr <- cor(p_mat, use="pairwise.complete.obs")

# distance matrix for clustering
dist_mat <- dist(1 - p_corr)

hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method="average")

# Plot dendrogram
plot(hc, main = "Disease Clustering by P-value Similarity",
     xlab="", sub="", cex=1.2)


p_corr_melt <- melt(p_corr)

# order axes by dendrogram
disease_order <- hc$labels[hc$order]
p_corr_melt$Var1 <- factor(p_corr_melt$Var1, levels=disease_order)
p_corr_melt$Var2 <- factor(p_corr_melt$Var2, levels=disease_order)

pval_heatmap <- ggplot(p_corr_melt, aes(Var1, Var2, fill=value)) +
  geom_tile(color="grey90") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="#2166ac", high="#b2182b", mid="white",
                       limits=c(-1,1), midpoint=0, name="Correlation") +
  geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.2f", value)), size=4) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(title="P-value Correlation Across Diseases", x="", y="")


beta_mat <- full_tbl %>%
  select(starts_with("beta_"))

beta_corr <- cor(beta_mat, use="pairwise.complete.obs")
beta_corr_melt <- melt(beta_corr)

# cluster disease order from p-values for consistency
beta_corr_melt$Var1 <- factor(beta_corr_melt$Var1, levels=disease_order)
beta_corr_melt$Var2 <- factor(beta_corr_melt$Var2, levels=disease_order)

beta_heatmap <- ggplot(beta_corr_melt, aes(Var1, Var2, fill=value)) +
  geom_tile(color="grey90") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="#2166ac", high="#b2182b", mid="white",
                       limits=c(-1,1), midpoint=0, name="Correlation") +
  geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.2f", value)), size=4) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(title="Effect Size Correlation Across Diseases", x="", y="")


snp_mat <- full_tbl %>%
  select(SNP, starts_with("p_")) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("p_"), ~ -log10(pmax(.,1e-300)))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("SNP")

# order diseases according to dendrogram
snp_mat <- snp_mat[, paste0("p_", disease_order)]

# scale rows for visual clarity
pheatmap(snp_mat,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         fontsize = 10,
         main = "SNP–Disease Heatmap (–log10(P))")

library(patchwork)

(pval_heatmap | beta_heatmap) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Cross-Disease Genetic Architecture at the MOBP Locus")
```

```{r}
plot_manhattan <- function(df, disease_name){
  ggplot(df, aes(x = pos, y = -log10(P))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2, color = "steelblue") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Manhattan Plot —", disease_name),
      x = "Genomic Position (chr3)",
      y = expression(-log[10](P))
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(5e-8),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(coloc)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

build_cc_dataset <- function(df, N, s, label) {
  list(
    snp     = df$SNP,
    beta    = df$beta,
    varbeta = df$SE^2,
    MAF     = df$MAF,
    N       = N,
    s       = s,          # proportion of cases (N_cases / N)
    type    = "cc",
    label   = label
  )
}

## ------------ Sample sizes from your message ------------
```

```{r}
datasets <- list(
  ALS = build_cc_dataset(ALS_h, N_ALS, s_ALS, "ALS"),
  PSP = build_cc_dataset(PSP_h, N_PSP, s_PSP, "PSP"),
  PD  = build_cc_dataset(PD_h,  N_PD,  s_PD,  "PD"),
  MSA = build_cc_dataset(MSA_h, N_MSA, s_MSA, "MSA"),
  AD  = build_cc_dataset(AD_h,  N_AD,  s_AD,  "AD"),
  CJD = build_cc_dataset(CJD_h, N_CJD, s_CJD, "CJD"),
  FTD = build_cc_dataset(FTD_h, N_FTD, s_FTD, "FTD")
)

## If/when you have LBD_h ready:
# datasets$LBD <- build_cc_dataset(LBD_h, N_LBD, s_LBD, "LBD")
trait_pairs <- combn(names(datasets), 2, simplify = FALSE)

coloc_results_list <- lapply(trait_pairs, function(p) {
  t1 <- p[[1]]
  t2 <- p[[2]]
  message("Running coloc: ", t1, " vs ", t2)

  res <- coloc.abf(
    dataset1 = datasets[[t1]],
    dataset2 = datasets[[t2]],
    p1  = 1e-4,
    p2  = 1e-4,
    p12 = 1e-5
  )

  summary_row <- data.frame(
    trait1 = t1,
    trait2 = t2,
    nsnps  = res$summary["nsnps"],
    PP.H0  = res$summary["PP.H0.abf"],
    PP.H1  = res$summary["PP.H1.abf"],
    PP.H2  = res$summary["PP.H2.abf"],
    PP.H3  = res$summary["PP.H3.abf"],
    PP.H4  = res$summary["PP.H4.abf"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  list(summary = summary_row, full = res)
})

coloc_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(coloc_results_list, `[[`, "summary"))
coloc_summary

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Make sure PP.H4 is numeric
coloc_summary <- coloc_summary %>%
  mutate(PP.H4 = as.numeric(PP.H4))

pp_h4_mat <- coloc_summary %>%
  select(trait1, trait2, PP.H4)

ggplot(pp_h4_mat, aes(trait1, trait2, fill = PP.H4)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#f7fbff",
    mid = "#c6dbef",
    high = "#08306b",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    midpoint = 0.5,
    name = "PP.H4"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", PP.H4)), color = "black", size = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Coloc PP.H4 Across Disease Pairs",
    x = "", y = ""
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
get_pair_res <- function(a, b, trait_pairs, coloc_results_list) {
  idx <- which(sapply(trait_pairs, function(p) all(sort(p) == sort(c(a, b)))))
  coloc_results_list[[idx]]$full
}

res_PSP_ALS <- get_pair_res("PSP", "ALS", trait_pairs, coloc_results_list)
res_PSP_ALS$summary
head(res_PSP_ALS$results)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# reference positions from PSP_f
ref_pos <- PSP_f %>% select(SNP, pos)

pair_df <- res_PSP_ALS$results %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(SNP = snp) %>%
  left_join(ref_pos, by = "SNP") %>%
  filter(!is.na(pos))

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

## 1. Positions from PSP_f
ref_pos <- PSP_f %>%
  select(SNP, pos)

## 2. Coloc results as data.frame
coloc_psp_als <- as.data.frame(res_PSP_ALS$results) %>%
  rename(SNP = snp) %>%
  select(SNP, SNP.PP.H4)

## 3. Join everything
plot_df <- ref_pos %>%
  left_join(PSP_h %>% select(SNP, P_PSP = P), by = "SNP") %>%
  left_join(ALS_h %>% select(SNP, P_ALS = P), by = "SNP") %>%
  left_join(coloc_psp_als, by = "SNP") %>%
  filter(!is.na(P_PSP), !is.na(P_ALS), !is.na(SNP.PP.H4))

 
p_psp <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = pos, y = -log10(P_PSP))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8, color = "#377eb8") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "PSP",
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(-log[10](P))
  )

p_als <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = pos, y = -log10(P_ALS))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8, color = "#4daf4a") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "ALS",
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(-log[10](P))
  )

p_pph4 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = pos, y = SNP.PP.H4)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8, color = "#e41a1c") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "PSP–ALS coloc",
    x = "Position on chr3",
    y = "SNP.PP.H4"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.01, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50")

(p_psp / p_als / p_pph4) +
  plot_annotation(title = "PSP vs ALS colocalisation at MOBP locus")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

top_snps <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(desc(SNP.PP.H4)) %>%
  slice(1:10)   # tweak number as you like
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

library(dplyr)

top_snps <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(desc(SNP.PP.H4)) %>%
  slice(1:6)

x_min <- min(top_snps$pos) - 1e5   # 100 kb either side
x_max <- max(top_snps$pos) + 1e5

gws_line  <- -log10(5e-8)   # genome-wide significance
sugg_line <- -log10(1e-5)   # suggestive (optional)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

p_psp_zoom <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = pos, y = -log10(P_PSP))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = SNP.PP.H4), alpha = 0.85, size = 1.6) +
  geom_point(
    data  = top_snps,
    aes(x = pos, y = -log10(P_PSP)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    size  = 2.8,
    stroke = 0.6,
    fill   = "red",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data  = top_snps,
    aes(x = pos, y = -log10(P_PSP), label = SNP),
    size = 3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.size  = 0.25,
    box.padding   = 0.25,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    label.size    = NA
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("grey85", "royalblue3", "red3"),
    values  = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.1, max(plot_df$SNP.PP.H4, na.rm = TRUE))),
    name    = "SNP.PP.H4",
    limits  = c(0, max(plot_df$SNP.PP.H4, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) +
  # 🔹 genome-wide + suggestive lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = gws_line,  linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkred") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sugg_line, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40") +
  # 🔹 zoom to top region (x) and focus y on top signals
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min, x_max),
                  ylim = c(sugg_line - 1, max(-log10(plot_df$P_PSP), na.rm = TRUE) + 1)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "PSP −log10(P) at MOBP locus\n(coloured by PSP–ALS SNP.PP.H4)",
    x = "Position on chr3 (zoomed)",
    y = expression(-log[10](P))
  )
p_als_zoom <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = pos, y = -log10(P_ALS))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = SNP.PP.H4), alpha = 0.85, size = 1.6) +
  geom_point(
    data  = top_snps,
    aes(x = pos, y = -log10(P_ALS)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    size  = 2.8,
    stroke = 0.6,
    fill   = "red",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data  = top_snps,
    aes(x = pos, y = -log10(P_ALS), label = SNP),
    size = 3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.size  = 0.25,
    box.padding   = 0.25,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    label.size    = NA
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("grey85", "royalblue3", "red3"),
    values  = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.1, max(plot_df$SNP.PP.H4, na.rm = TRUE))),
    name    = "SNP.PP.H4",
    limits  = c(0, max(plot_df$SNP.PP.H4, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = gws_line,  linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkred") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sugg_line, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min, x_max),
                  ylim = c(sugg_line - 1, max(-log10(plot_df$P_ALS), na.rm = TRUE) + 1)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "ALS −log10(P) at MOBP locus\n(coloured by PSP–ALS SNP.PP.H4)",
    x = "Position on chr3 (zoomed)",
    y = expression(-log[10](P))
  )
library(patchwork)

p_psp_zoom + p_als_zoom + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
